Notes: THE HEAD COACH EXPLAINS A SCREEN (round AN, your note). One row = one box. SCREEN: base, brewery, shop or bounty (the Adventure board). REQUIRES: the usual condition language; a row that has played sets flag:guide_done_<ID>, so the next row can wait for it. SCENE: a Dialogue.csv scene shown in a box over the screen. HIGHLIGHT: the words on the button to light up after the box (it pulses until pressed; nothing is forced). THEN: what happens after the box, in the Progression.csv Do language - goto:base closes a window over the base. ONCE: true = only ever once. This row: the first brew - WORK IT on the Malthouse lights up.
After the first brew: you are short of ingredients for a proper beer, so off on an Adventure. Sets flag:intro_adventure and takes you back to the base.
At the base, the Head Coach says go on an Adventure, and the Adventure banner lights up (not forced). The board then gives you only your first team - MatchModes.csv intro_adventure.
The Traveling Merchant introduces himself. He trades beer for what you carried home: data/Shop.csv rows priced in Reed and Bog Iron (Currencies.csv). This is where the intro stops for now.
